description: Defines utility template functions for summing and multiplying integers in containers or via iterators, and for calculating the number of elements based on tensor dimensions.

methods.name: sum_integers
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a container of integers, accumulating into int64_t to prevent overflow.

methods.name: sum_integers
methods.description: Calculates the sum of integers in a range specified by iterators, accumulating into int64_t.

methods.name: multiply_integers
methods.description: Calculates the product of a container of integers, accumulating into int64_t.

methods.name: multiply_integers
methods.description: Calculates the product of integers in a range specified by iterators, accumulating into int64_t.

methods.name: numelements_from_dim
methods.description: Returns the product of tensor dimensions starting from index k.

methods.name: numelements_to_dim
methods.description: Returns the product of tensor dimensions up to index k.

methods.name: numelements_between_dim
methods.description: Returns the product of tensor dimensions between indices k and l.
